sources.title: Compiler API (TypeScript)
sources.technique: ts.createSourceFile parses a single in-memory string into a SourceFile AST; for syntactic-only codemods/formatting use createSourceFile with setParentNodes to read positions
sources.applicability: exactly the AST-lite tier ODG needs — no Program/build/type-checker
sources.limits: syntactic tier = no type resolution (semantic checks out of scope)

sources.title: Public Compiler API (microsoft/TypeScript)
sources.technique: SourceFile/Node AST; parseDiagnostics surface syntax errors

sources.title: Getting Started With Handling TypeScript ASTs
sources.technique: dead code = unexported symbols never referenced within their own file (file-local search space)
sources.applicability: dead-require analysis must be file-local + conservative
sources.limits: file-local only; cross-file needs a Program

findings.statement: ts.createSourceFile (syntactic tier, setParentNodes, no type-checker/build) is the standard, fast, safe way to parse TS for codemods; parseDiagnostics expose syntax errors.
findings.appliedInV154: odg-ast-operations uses ts.createSourceFile for REAL AST parsing (static, NO code execution); parse errors ⇒ NATIVE_REFUSED; honest AST-lite (not regex-pretending-to-be-AST).

findings.statement: Dead-code analysis without a full Program is FILE-LOCAL (unexported/local symbols, references within the same file).
findings.appliedInV154: dead-require-analysis is file-local, DIAGNOSTIC-only, conservative: safeToRemove only when the binding has 0 AST references and is unambiguous; destructuring/side-effect/dynamic ⇒ NOT safeToRemove.

findings.statement: Semantic tasks (type alignment) need a type-checker/Program; the syntactic tier cannot resolve types.
findings.appliedInV154: type/import alignment that needs semantic understanding is REFUSED/ESCALATED — not faked at the syntactic tier.

dependencyNote: typescript@5.9.3 is ALREADY a repo dev dependency (node_modules/typescript); NO new external dependency added. It is loaded statically at module top and used ONLY to PARSE text (no code execution, no eval, no dynamic import of mission input).
honesty: Reference techniques, NOT demonstrated ODG capabilities beyond what V154 builds. Syntactic-tier only; semantic transforms refused. No paid API/credential/external write. €0 clients.
